title: 29 Marketing Skills Claude Gives You for Free
description:
There are 29 completely free claude skills built specifically for marketing. Ad creatives, copywriting, email sequences, full content strategies. Search Marketing Skills Claude, download the skill file, and upload it to Claude in sixty seconds. Now Claude uses that skill every time you ask a marketing question and delivers full done-for-you outputs. The best way to use claude for marketing and ai automation without paying an agency. Full claude skills tutorial showing exactly how to install and use them.
